verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation publishes documentation, so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions llms.txt, machine-readable docs, or docs written for agents. The general developer guides in fedora-docs-17 are human-oriented and do not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
